title: OpenFarm Slicer Provisioning Manifest
description: Maintainer-authored declaration of which (engine, version, platform) slicer builds to fetch into the application's bundled slicer directory. Consumed only by the dev/build-time provisioning tool (tools/provision-slicers) — never read by the running application (FR-012/FR-018).

schemaVersion.description: Manifest format version for forward-compat; current = 1.

slicers.description: Desired set of slicers to bundle. Append-only across releases by product commitment (FR-008a) — entries are added, never removed.

engine.description: Supported slicer engine (FR-001). Each maps to a fixed official GitHub release source resolved by the provisioning tool.

platform.description: Target host platform for the fetched build (FR-009/FR-010).

version.description: Exact upstream release string, verbatim, as published on the engine's GitHub releases (e.g. "2.2.0", "2.5.59.13", "01.10.00.00"). Stored/displayed verbatim by the app (FR-005). No leading 'v'.

platforms.description: Which platform builds of this (engine, version) to fetch. A platform whose upstream asset does not exist fails only that entry, not the run (FR-015).

notes.description: Optional free-text maintainer note (e.g. why this version is pinned).
